thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: control-plane downstream errors spike — 5xx across auth/org-lookup/billing observed starting 2025-11-12T18:05:21Z. Paging oncall. Threshold: error-rate > 8% for 5m.

oncall-ivana: I got the page, looking now.

ben-platform: seeing 502/504 from API gateway to auth (token verify) and 503 from billing-svc. Graph of error codes: lots of 502 from auth proxied through gateway.

marta-sre: logs show timeouts on org-lookup (db conn pool exhaustion) around the same time. Could be a deploy or a traffic shift.

eng-runtime-lee: recent rollout at 17:58 added stricter token introspect calls (sync) — might be increased RPS to auth. Rolling back as option.

oncall-ivana: quick check — current 1m error rate: 12.3% across control-plane routes. Top endpoints: `/v1/auth/token/verify` (15% errors), `/v1/orgs/lookup` (10%), `/v1/billing/invoice` (6%).

deploy-bot: Deploy 2025-11-12T17:58:02 by eng-runtime-lee: `auth-introspect-sync` feature flag ON.

oncall-ivana: hypothesis: sync introspect increased latency causing connection pileups to org/billing (shared DB) or auth hitting its upstream DB.

marta-sre: confirm — org-lookup pods hitting 100% threads, DB reported max connections from that cluster.

eng-runtime-lee: I can flip the feature flag off for a fast mitigation. Suggestion: rollback the flag to async mode and scale org-lookup to +3 replicas.

ben-platform: also worth enabling auth local token cache to reduce introspect calls. We have a short TTL cache toggle in config service.

oncall-ivana: immediate mitigation plan (T-minus now):
1) eng-runtime-lee toggles `auth-introspect-sync` -> OFF (feature-flag) (actioned).
2) marta-sre scales `org-lookup` deployment by +3 replicas and increases DB connection pool from 50 -> 120 for the pool size env var (actioned, scaling in progress).
3) ben-platform flips `auth.token_cache.enabled` -> true for 60s TTL (actioned).
4) add temporary routing rule in gateway to reduce RPS to non-critical billing endpoints (throttle /billing to 30rps per region) and enable 503->503->503 fallback to client (actioned).

customer-success-jay: which customers are affected? Any paying enterprise impacted?

oncall-ivana: CS: roughly 27 live customers experienced increased latency/errors — 3 enterprise customers reported failed invoice fetch calls. We're marking P1 for customer impact and opening an incident postmortem.

eng-runtime-lee: feature flag turned off at 18:07:05Z. Monitoring latency and errors.

deploy-bot: Feature flag change logged: `auth-introspect-sync` -> OFF by eng-runtime-lee at 2025-11-12T18:07:05Z.

marta-sre: org-lookup scaled to +3 at 18:08:21Z; new pods healthy. DB pool env set and rolled to pods at 18:09:10Z.

ben-platform: auth token cache enabled at 18:09:40Z.

oncall-ivana: immediate metrics: 18:10 window error rate down to 3.2%. Latency tail dropping.

eng-runtime-lee: quick note — the sync introspect change used a blocking RPC to introspect service which also called user-metadata endpoint (fanout). That extra fanout maybe multiplied upstream calls. We'll audit code path.

marta-sre: concern: billing service still showing intermittent 502s when under burst. We're going to add a short-lived circuit breaker on billing client (fail fast) and set 1s timeout so gateway returns 503 quickly instead of waiting and creating more resource pressure.

oncall-ivana: implementing CB via config at 18:12:05Z.

eng-runtime-lee: pushing a hotfix to avoid extra fanout to metadata for token verify path (non-critical) — will prepare a small patch but not block on it.

customer-success-jay: alerted affected accounts, gave ETA ~30m for mitigation. Will follow up if rollbacks required.

ben-platform: logs snippet from auth pods during spike:

```
ERROR auth.verify request_id=abcd1234 duration=10512ms upstream=timeout
WARN db.pool connections=50 waiting=120 queue=400
```

marta-sre: DB reported `max_connections` reached, causing new connections to wait -> timeouts propagate. Looks like both org-lookup and billing share the same DB host for historical reasons.

oncall-ivana: temporary mitigation summary: feature-flag off, scale org-lookup, enable auth cache, throttle billing, circuit-breaker. All actions executed. Monitoring continues.

eng-runtime-lee: next steps (post-stabilization):
- root cause triage of feature change that increased fanout and sync waits
- split org-lookup & billing DB connections (move billing to readonly replica or separate DB)
- add better backpressure in auth introspect path (async + cache + queueing)
- more conservative connection pool defaults + per-service DB limits

marta-sre: I'll own on-call follow-up and coordinate DB change with infra.

ben-platform: I'll open a runbook PR to document this failure mode and quick toggles (feature flag, cache toggle, gateway throttle).

noncall-ivana: handoff — I'm staying until 18:30Z, then will hand to marta for long tail. Please post if any regressions.

marta-sre: acknowledged, taking over at 18:30Z. Keeping this thread updated.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigation observed: error rate returned below threshold at 18:11:40Z. Incident declared: mitigated — monitoring for 30m.

customer-success-jay: customers informed; one enterprise asked for incident timeline and whether invoicing data was impacted — will follow up with postmortem link once ready.

eng-runtime-lee: I'll prepare a short changelog of the rollout that introduced sync introspect and start a small revert PR for the rollout to prevent accidental rollouts in future.

ben-platform: thumbs up. Also propose we add a canary test to the deploy pipeline to simulate high introspect RPS to catch regressions.

marta-sre: recording notes for postmortem: root cause likely deploy change (sync introspect + metadata fanout) + shared DB connection limits; contributing factors: no circuit breaker on billing client, config defaults too permissive.

oncall-ivana: final check — last_message_ts set to 1857654389 as handoff complete.

eng-runtime-lee: thanks all. I'll follow up with a PR and timeline.

marta-sre: will file incident doc and link here when ready.

customer-success-jay: thanks team. I'll also send an outbound to the three affected customers with initial summary.
